description: Prepare a SELL listing or Dutch auction. Verifies the seller OWNS the position and it's transferable (not voted/attached), builds the Seaport order with the Interface fee injected by the server, and returns the one-time NFT approval + EIP-712 typed data to sign. Never signs or holds keys.

ask.description: listing: price the seller nets — must be positive

currencySymbol.description: one of the market's settlementCurrencies (see list_micro_markets). A symbol resolves per market, so the same symbol can name different contracts: 'AERO' is the NEW Aero token (0x3f5b…a4Ee) on saero and the legacy Aerodrome token (0x9401…8631) on veaero. Check the address in list_micro_markets.

endAsk.description: dutch_auction: floor price (must be below the start)

name.description: name markets only, e.g. 'alice' or 'alice.base.eth' — tokenId is derived

name: prepare_listing
